article.title: Powers of competent authority.
article.content:
269MPowers of competent authority.

Section 269M  ·  Chapter XX-A  ·  page 925 of the Act
The competent authority shall have, for the purposes of this Chapter, all the powers that a Principal Commissioner or Commissioner has, for the purposes of this Act, under section 131.
